title: Park for free when you ride public transport
summary: Learn how to park for free for up to 18 hours a day at a Transport Park&Ride car park when you use public transport.
intro:
If you travel on public transport, you can park for free for up to 18 hours each day at a Transport Park&Ride car park.

To be eligible for free parking, you must:

If you’re not using public transport or do not exit the car park within the 18-hour free parking window, fees will apply.

Note: You can use an Adult, Child/Youth, Senior/Pensioner, Concession, Employee or Free Travel Opal card. Single trip tickets and School Opal cards are not accepted.
who_can_apply: Must exit the car park within the 18-hour free parking window.
what_you_need: Adult, Child/Youth, Senior/Pensioner, Concession, Employee or Free Travel Opal card.

faqs.q: How long can I park for free?
faqs.a: You can park for free for up to 18 hours each day at a Transport Park&Ride car park.

faqs.q: What cards are accepted for free parking?
faqs.a: You can use an Adult, Child/Youth, Senior/Pensioner, Concession, Employee or Free Travel Opal card.

faqs.q: What happens if I don't use public transport or leave the car park?
faqs.a: If you are not using public transport or do not exit the car park within the 18-hour free parking window, fees will apply.
